metadata.title: Common Shade passive cooling evidence library
metadata.review_type: Structured rapid evidence map, not an exhaustive systematic review or meta-analysis
metadata.scope: Global search, prioritising South and Southeast Asia; passive and explicitly identified low-energy variants. Some records have only one verified place or modelling evidence.
metadata.basis_note: The evidence status measured includes studies/analyses as requested. Every quantitative effect separately labels measured, modelled or reported basis. Test identifies small prototypes; evaluated requires independent programme evaluation.
metadata.missing_data: JSON null means not verified/not publicly disclosed in the reviewed sources, not zero. Consult field notes.
metadata.taxonomy_note: Mappings use the user-supplied IDs rather than assuming a complete audit of current live-site counts. Associations are analytical, not measured loop interruption.
metadata.cost_note: Historical local prices; retain unit and scope. Annual-average INR/USD rates; publication-year proxies explicitly labelled when price observation year is unknown. No inflation-adjusted or current universal price.
metadata.publication_note: No automatic website publication recommended. Review claims, scale, local design and permissions; gaps are itemised rather than filled with estimates.
metadata.no_endorsement: Organisation/product mentions describe relevant published work and do not imply partnership or endorsement.

passive_solutions.name: Solar-reflective roof coatings

mechanism.text: Reflect more incoming sunlight, reducing absorbed solar heat and heat conducted through the roof. High thermal emittance can also help reject absorbed heat.

suits.reason: Both climates: solar rejection does not require dry air; humidity, soiling and roof construction still affect delivered benefit.
suits.interpretation: Physics-based transfer judgement; not a guarantee in every building.

effect.result: About 1°C lower mean indoor air temperature for painted tin versus unpainted tin.
effect.sample: 16 households overall: one painted-roof intervention compared with three controls on its comparison day; seven daytime hours
effect.baseline: Unpainted tin mean 34.6°C versus coated tin 33.5°C
effect.limitations: Non-randomised houses; repeated sensor readings are not independent households; no health endpoint.

passive_solutions.name: Reflective single-ply roof membranes

mechanism.text: A light, solar-reflective sheet forms the exposed roof surface and reduces solar absorption; seams and attachment provide the waterproofing system.

suits.reason: Both climates in principle; aged reflectance, waterproofing and moisture design matter. Cold-climate energy findings cannot be copied to tropical housing.
suits.interpretation: Physics-based transfer judgement; not a guarantee in every building.

effect.result: Programme reported average indoor air temperature 2°C lower in membrane-roof homes than similar untreated homes.
effect.sample: 25 roofs in pilot; sensor sample count not stated
effect.limitations: Implementation factsheet; no independent evaluation or sensor protocol available here.

passive_solutions.name: Secondary or false ceiling with an air gap

mechanism.text: A secondary ceiling separates occupants from the hot roof and creates an intervening air layer. The material and air-gap arrangement determine conductive and radiant heat transfer.

suits.reason: Both climates, provided moisture, ceiling height and ventilation are considered; does not dehumidify hot-humid air.
suits.interpretation: Physics-based transfer judgement; not a guarantee in every building.

effect.baseline: Intervention mean 33.50°C; asbestos control 35.88°C; tin control 35.44°C
effect.limitations: Non-randomised cross-house comparison. Derived subtraction of reported means, not a paired estimate; no health endpoint.
